name: toggl-track
label: Toggl Track
description: Toggl Track is a time tracking application that allows users to track their daily activities across different platforms. Works with classic Toggl Track and Toggl 2.0 accounts.

token.label: Toggl Track (Classic)
token.description:
Use this for classic Toggl Track accounts (track.toggl.com).

1. Log in to [Toggl Track](https://track.toggl.com).
2. Open your **Profile settings** (https://track.toggl.com/profile).
3. Scroll to **API Token** at the bottom of the page and copy it (a 32-character code).
